<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תשרי_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518913940_theRebbe_399" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_A9_D7_A8_D7_99_meluket__BH_POST_1766518913940_theRebbe_399__p001">
  <section v="0">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section contains the opening header and date of the maamar.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">With the help of Heaven.</t>
    <t s="1">The second day of Rosh HaShanah,</t>
    <t s="2">the year 5747*</t>
  </section>
  <section v="1">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section notes that the text is a transcription of an oral discourse.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">– Transcription –</t>
  </section>
  <section v="2">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that Rosh HaShanah is called "Keseh" because the Sefirah of Malchus is concealed, and the primary service is to build Malchus through the shofar blasts.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">"Blow the shofar at the new moon, at the concealment [bakeseh] for our holiday" etc.1,</t>
    <t s="1">And it is explained in this regard by the Rebbe, my father-in-law, the Nasi of our generation</t>
    <t s="2">[in his maamar beginning with the words "Tik'u" of the year 57072,</t>
    <t s="3">forty years ago,</t>
    <t s="4">(for after forty years a person stands on the understanding of his teacher3)],</t>
    <t s="5">that our sages, of blessed memory, said4</t>
    <t s="6">regarding the verse: "Which is the holiday on which the month is concealed? You must say this is Rosh HaShanah."</t>
    <t s="7">For "bakeseh" [means] the throne [keseh] of Hashem, where "Hashem" refers to the Sefirah of Malchus, and "keseh" means concealment; and Rosh HaShanah is called "Keseh" because on Rosh HaShanah the Sefirah of Malchus is concealed and hidden in the essential concealment, etc.</t>
    <t s="8">(And perhaps one may add a connection to the matter of "the holiday on which the month is concealed" simply,</t>
    <t s="9">for "month" simply refers to the moon,</t>
    <t s="10">and it is known that the moon is the Sefirah of Malchus),</t>
    <t s="11">and therefore the primary service of Rosh HaShanah is the building of the Sefirah of Malchus, as our sages, of blessed memory, said5</t>
    <t s="12">"Recite before Me [verses of] Kingship, so that you make Me King over you," etc.,</t>
    <t s="13">and in order to draw down the aspect of Malchus, it is through the shofar blast, as it is written, "Blow [the shofar]" etc.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
